name: Echoing Major Ability
body:
Your granted abilities do no expend immediately after they are used.

Prerequisite(s): Occultist level 10.

Benefit(s): When you activate a major granted ability, you can choose for it not to become expended after its use. At the end of your next turn after using the echoing major ability, it is immediately expended (even if you did not use it again) and it is expended for double the normal number of rounds (10 rounds for most abilities, 8 if you have a special feat or ability that reduces the number of rounds the major granted ability is expended for).

Special: This is an alteration secret. Only one alteration secret can be applied to a given granted ability at a time.
